heroHeadline: Merz Visits Kyiv as Ukraine Faces Winter Austerity and India Signals Diplomatic Shift
heroSubtitle: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz made an unannounced visit to Kyiv on October 4 as Russian strikes continue. Ukraine faces severe budget pressures heading into its third wartime winter, while India signals more active diplomatic engagement in the conflict.
